body:
## Parent

#1090

## What to build

Make public stream-table results and schemas compare exactly against an independently computed expected result at a known source checkpoint. Strengthen the shared comparator and the representative scan, aggregate, join, duplicate, and set-operation callers. Cover a user column named `abpgt_x`, quoted identifiers, NULLs, and missing relations. Keep internal-counter checks separate. Reject type differences by default. Add normalization only for a supported real public-query case, and keep it narrow.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Correct representative fixtures pass; wrong values, row multiplicities, visible columns, and schemas fail.
- [ ] A comparator error or missing relation cannot pass. Expectations do not come from hidden extension counters or its own progress calculation.
- [ ] Controls that remove a compared user column or replace bag comparison with set comparison are caught in relevant PR and candidate runs.
- [ ] Recheck the current helper before changing it and preserve correct existing behavior.

## Blocked by

None (can start immediately).

## Historical context

Replaces the retained scope of #1044. Repository-wide helper migration is deferred. #1051 contributes the idea of local semantic controls; this issue does not build a general mutation platform.

---

<!-- acceptance-matrix:1091 -->
## Detailed acceptance matrix

These rows define the evidence required for acceptance. They do not claim completed verification.

### #1091: public results and schemas

Anchors: [oracle](https://github.com/trickle-labs/pg-trickle/blob/main/tests/e2e/oracle.rs),
[sensitivity tests](https://github.com/trickle-labs/pg-trickle/blob/main/tests/e2e_sensitivity_baseline_tests.rs),
[refresh tests](https://github.com/trickle-labs/pg-trickle/blob/main/tests/e2e_refresh_tests.rs),
[join tests](https://github.com/trickle-labs/pg-trickle/blob/main/tests/e2e_join_tests.rs),
[duplicate tests](https://github.com/trickle-labs/pg-trickle/blob/main/tests/e2e_keyless_duplicate_tests.rs), and
[set-operation tests](https://github.com/trickle-labs/pg-trickle/blob/main/tests/e2e_set_operation_tests.rs).
Unqualified case names in this subsection belong to the sensitivity target.

| ID | Source | Requirement and scope | Boundaries / counterexamples | Evidence type | Exact evidence | Done |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Q1091-R01 | [#1091](https://github.com/trickle-labs/pg-trickle/issues/1091), W/AC1/AC4 | Correct representative scan, aggregate, join, duplicate, and set-operation public results pass exact comparison. | Empty, one-row, duplicate-bearing, and post-mutation results; hidden counters used to manufacture public rows. | behavioral test | E: strengthen `test_refresh_mixed_dml`, `test_refresh_aggregate_correctness`, `test_inner_join_update_propagation`, `test_keyless_delete_one_duplicate`, `test_intersect_all_full`, and `test_except_all_full` in the targets above. Compare the actual public projection to a direct query at a quiescent committed checkpoint. Keep private-counter assertions separate. | [ ] |
| Q1091-R02 | [#1091](https://github.com/trickle-labs/pg-trickle/issues/1091), AC1 | Equal row counts cannot hide wrong values. | Actual `(1, apple),(2, banana)` versus expected `(1, apple),(2, orange)`. | behavioral test | E: `test_oracle_detects_same_count_different_content`. Assert one extra and one missing row with the expected payloads, not merely an error return. Include an equal-content baseline. | [ ] |
| Q1091-R03 | [#1091](https://github.com/trickle-labs/pg-trickle/issues/1091), AC1/AC3 | Comparison preserves duplicate multiplicity. | `{A,A,B}` versus `{A,B}`; replacing both `EXCEPT ALL` operations with `EXCEPT`. | behavioral test | E: `test_oracle_detects_duplicate_multiplicity_mismatch`. Require exactly one extra `A`. Run the set-comparison control and require this assertion to reject it in PR and candidate controls. | [ ] |
| Q1091-R04 | [#1091](https://github.com/trickle-labs/pg-trickle/issues/1091), W/AC1/AC3 | Every visible user column participates in comparison, including `abpgt_x`. | Missing column or wrong value only in `abpgt_x`; SQL `_` wildcard hiding it on both sides. | behavioral test | P: `test_oracle_detects_missing_user_column`, the identity required by #1093. Check equal baseline, missing-column schema mismatch, and changed-value mismatch. A control that removes this column from both projections must make the case fail. | [ ] |
| Q1091-R05 | [#1091](https://github.com/trickle-labs/pg-trickle/issues/1091), W/AC1 | Schemas agree in visible column count, order, names, types, typmods, and collation. Reject differences by default. | Same rows with renamed/reordered columns, incompatible types, different constrained typmods or collations. | behavioral test | E: `test_oracle_detects_schema_mismatch` and `test_oracle_detects_incompatible_type_mismatch`; P: `test_oracle_schema_boundaries_reject_mismatch`. Change one schema property per subcase and require a diagnostic identifying that property. Do not add a normalization subcase unless a supported real public-query case demonstrates that it is necessary. | [ ] |
| Q1091-R06 | [#1091](https://github.com/trickle-labs/pg-trickle/issues/1091), W | The comparator rejects type, typmod, and collation differences by default. | Current broad numeric, timestamp, or string families mask a real schema difference. | invariant | P: Add an allowlist beside `compare_signatures` only when a supported real public-query fixture demonstrates that normalization is necessary. Document the allowed pair and a neighboring rejected pair. | [ ] |
| Q1091-R07 | [#1091](https://github.com/trickle-labs/pg-trickle/issues/1091), W | Quoted relation and column identifiers are compared correctly. | Schema-qualified mixed case, embedded double quote, whitespace, or a quote in a relation name. | behavioral test | P: `test_oracle_quoted_identifiers_compare_exactly`. Create quoted names through SQL, compare equal values, then change only the quoted column and require the concrete row difference. A parse error is not a successful mismatch check. | [ ] |
| Q1091-R08 | [#1091](https://github.com/trickle-labs/pg-trickle/issues/1091), W/AC1 | NULL values retain PostgreSQL bag-comparison semantics. | Two NULL rows versus one; NULL versus a non-NULL value; NULL join/set-operation output. | behavioral test | P: `test_oracle_null_multiplicity_compares_exactly`; E: `e2e_set_operation_tests::test_set_operation_with_nulls`. Equal NULL bags pass; each differing bag reports the expected extra/missing multiplicity. | [ ] |
| Q1091-R09 | [#1091](https://github.com/trickle-labs/pg-trickle/issues/1091), AC2 | A missing relation cannot pass comparison. | Missing actual relation, missing expected-query source, or empty metadata mistaken for an empty table. | behavioral test | P: `test_oracle_missing_relation_fails_closed`. Require a relation-specific diagnostic and failed test outcome in both missing-relation variants. Two existing empty relations must still compare successfully. | [ ] |
| Q1091-R10 | [#1091](https://github.com/trickle-labs/pg-trickle/issues/1091), AC2 | A comparator execution error cannot be reported as an equal result. | Permission failure or invalid expected query versus a genuine row/schema mismatch. | behavioral test | P: `test_oracle_query_error_fails_closed`. Run the comparator with a deliberately invalid query and a denied read, require an explicit error/non-passing outcome, then show a valid equal comparison still passes. | [ ] |
| Q1091-R11 | [#1091](https://github.com/trickle-labs/pg-trickle/issues/1091), W/AC2 | Expected public results are independent of hidden extension counters and progress. | Corrupted public rows still pass because the oracle reconstructs them from private state. | behavioral test | P: `test_oracle_public_setop_rows_are_not_reconstructed`. Compare a supported public set-operation result to literal/direct-query expectations. In an isolated control, leave private counts plausible while changing public rows; require failure. Retain separate private-state tests. | [ ] |
<!-- /acceptance-matrix:1091 -->

comments.body: Resolved by merged PR #1100. Proof: 11/11 requirements proven; representative scan, aggregate, join, duplicate, INTERSECT ALL, and EXCEPT ALL E2E tests passed.

title: Make public-result and schema comparisons trustworthy
